### Praying the Names of God - September 28
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-october-10.html
Passage: 1 Kings 8:28-29
Points:
- God established the temple in Jerusalem as the earthly dwelling place where His name resides.
- Solomon pleaded for God to keep His eyes on the temple day and night to hear and forgive His people.
- Invoking the name of God means calling upon His very presence, authority, character, and power.
- The name of God is not a magic charm; it must be spoken in genuine faith and humble repentance.
- Jesus ultimately revealed the Father's name and invites His followers to pray in His name.
